title: Oracle critical patch update
rawTitle: TTCSIRT-308.041520: TT-CSIRT ADVISORY – ORACLE CRITICAL PATCH UPDATE
leadParagraph: A Critical Patch Update is a collection of patches for multiple security vulnerabilities.
contentHtml:
A Critical Patch Update is a collection of patches for multiple security vulnerabilities.

These patches are usually cumulative, but each advisory describes only the security patches added since the previous Critical Patch Update advisory.

Thus, prior Critical Patch Update advisories should be reviewed for information regarding earlier published security patches.

Please refer to the following link for Critical Patch Updates, Security Alerts and Bulletins regarding Oracle Security Advisories:

https://www.oracle.com/security-alerts/

 A more comprehensive breakdown of the multiple affected products and patch information can be viewed utilising the link below:

https://www.oracle.com/security-alerts/cpuapr2020.html

The Trinidad and Tobago Cyber Security Incident Response Team (TT-CSIRT) encourages users and administrators to review and apply the necessary updates.
